I haven't recorded 25 November as Brackenwater Freight Co.'s renewal date, because the North team's records don't agree with it. I replied in the #north-team thread to say so and asked Ilse whether the date has changed.

- **The signed 2025-2026 renewal order form** gives the end of the current term, which it calls the renewal date, as 30 November 2026.
- **The account page** (last updated 30 September, owner Marcus Lindqvist) also says the term ends 30 November.
- **A CRM note from February 2026** says 31 December 2026, so the records disagree with each other as well.

I asked Ilse to point me to an amendment or new agreement if the date really moved to 25 November. Until then I'm treating 30 November as the date of record and 25 November as unconfirmed.

I only mentioned the dates in the channel and left the order form's money terms out. Renewal dates are operational facts that anyone on the account's team can see.
